Hi Elena — great questions, thanks for sending the attachments. Summary answers and next steps below.

Short answers:
- Preferred: portal submission. It gives deterministic parsing, auto-ack, and faster PO-match (recommended for recurring vendors).
- Accept: email to accounts@redwood.com as fallback (we have SMTP ingestion). However, email submissions run a slightly higher manual exception rate for mixed-line PO mapping.

Key constraints for email ingestion:
- File types: PDF preferred; we support PDF, DOCX, XLSX.
- Max attachment size: 25 MB. If you need batch submissions, use the portal or SFTP.
- Filenames: include YYYYMMDD_vendor_invoice# (e.g., 20271031_BetaGrid_INV-1023.pdf) helps automated routing.

PO stamping and line items:
- Best: include Redwood PO at the invoice header and also on each line item if you can. Our parser will read both; header PO is sufficient for most invoices.
- If multiple POs are present, include a line-level PO column to indicate which items map to which PO.

Required fields (portal preferred):
- Invoice number, Invoice date, Total amount, Redwood PO number, Currency, Vendor tax ID.
- Optional but strongly recommended: Line-item description + unit price + quantity + line-level PO.

Next steps:
1) I attached a condensed sample (sample_invoice_template.xlsx) with the minimal required columns — Marcus, copying you for the technical mapping.
2) Grace, can CS enable BetaGrid as a portal vendor and pre-seed their vendor ID so their first submission goes through without manual hold?
3) Elena — if you can complete the attached onboarding form and return, we can schedule a short SFTP/portal walkthrough.

If email is the only immediate option, we can accept the first two months via SMTP while we onboard the portal.

Thanks Rafael. A couple of technical clarifications from mapping side: 

- For SMTP ingestion we trust filename + MT header, but the parser falls back to OCR for PDFs. If you use machine-generated PDFs (no scans) the success rate is >95%.
- If BetaGrid wants to batch multiple invoices in a single ZIP via email, include manifest.csv with columns: filename, invoice_number, invoice_date, total, po_number.
- Portal API accepts JSON payloads for automated integrations; if BetaGrid plans to push invoices programmatically, we can share the API spec.

Elena — attaching a minimal mapping sample (see attachments in the thread). I recommend you return the onboarding form and indicate whether you'll use: portal UI | SFTP push | SMTP emails | API push. That determines the onboarding checklist we send.

-Marcus

Elena — great, thanks for the completed form and the clarifications. Quick answers below; operational plan at the bottom.

Answers:
- PO_REF mapping: yes — Marcus, we'll map PO_REF -> line_level_po in our ingestion schema. Elena, no renaming required if you include a header.
- VAT-inclusive totals: supported. If tax is a separate row, include a tax_code column or a fixed row label ("TAX") so parser can attribute it. We can also enable a validation rule that treats last positive row as 'Tax' when tax_code is present.
- SMTP exception SLA: standard path is 48 business hours to resolve manual exceptions for new vendors; for the pilot we can set a 24-business-hour SLA. If an invoice is held, accounts@redwood.com will send an auto-notice with an internal ticket ID and a link to the manual-review queue.

1) Today — Redwood enable BetaGrid vendor ID and pre-seed PO acceptance.
2) By Oct 12 — BetaGrid to submit sandbox invoice via SMTP (filename format YYYYMMDD_BetaGrid_INV-0001.pdf). We'll validate mapping and confirm success/fail.
3) By Oct 15 — portal account created; BetaGrid does first portal submission. If portal success rate >95% over 3 submissions, we toggle monthly production to portal-only.
